why: All three checks pass; I could not refute it. The same line's third sentence states the default rule the claim asserts: "When omitted, official Anthropic marketplaces default to `true` and all other marketplaces default to `false`." (2) CITED FILE:LINE ACCURATE: packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-marketplace-entries.ts:104-111 is `DeliveredMarketplaceEntryV1` with exactly `name`, `source`, `refName`; :346-367 is the loop in `parseDeliveredMarketplaceEntryList` that builds rows from `row.name`/`row.source`/`row.ref` only. UP: the only consumer of `DeliveredMarketplaceEntryV1` is `MarketplaceRegistrySource.ensureDeliveredMarketplaces`/`deliverMarketplaces` (packages/shared/src/marketplace/registry-source.ts:348-380), which forwards only `source`, `refName`, `displayName` into `add()` — nothing upstream already handles `autoUpdate`. The claimed `grep -a -E 'pluginAutoUpdate|updateMarketplaces|refreshMarketplace'` over packages/ apps/ scripts/ is genuinely empty (exit 1); I used -a throughout for the NUL-byte trap. correctedState: Confirmed with three line-cite corrections and one duplicate flag. `DeliveredMarketplaceEntryV1` (packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-marketplace-entries.ts:104-111) carries only `name`, `source`, `refName`. The three-field row shape is produced by `deliveredRows` at :384-406 (not :346-367, which is the consuming loop in `parseDeliveredMarketplaceEntryList`), so `autoUpdate` is dropped there. `skipLfs` — which settings.md:877 places INSIDE the `source` object alongside `repo`/`url`, not beside it — is dropped one function earlier by `deliveredMarketplaceSource` (:285-317), which flattens the documented source object to a bare string. Neither field reaches the only consumer, `MarketplaceRegistrySource.deliverMarketplaces` (packages/shared/src/marketplace/registry-source.ts:355-368), which forwards `source`/`refName`/`displayName` alone. The background update the field would drive also does not exist: `availableUpdateVersion` has no producer (only pass-throughs at capabilities/resolver.ts:2201 and capabilities/views.ts:403), so capabilities/views.ts:443's `canUpdate: !!plugin.availableUpdateVersion` is always false, `upgrade()` (registry-source.ts:828) only re-fetches the catalog clone, and the sole background work — `ensureBackgroundFetch` (registry-source.ts:498) — is fired from the browse read path, not after startup. Worth fixing while nearby: the comment at registry-source.ts:693 asserts its allowlist gate covers "the background auto-update", naming a mechanism this fork does not have. All `autoUpdate` identifiers in the repo belong to the unrelated electron-updater subsystem (apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts).
